title: October Grove - Continuous Party Video
method: Initial 16-frame ending survey, then one-second ending sequences and opening surveys, followed by independently sought frames at 0.3-second intervals around chosen cuts. Extra coda and opening frames inspected for exceptions. Editorial cut points, not automatic credit detection or a full human screening. Original files unchanged. Ranges are start-inclusive/end-exclusive in source seconds.
sequence: original approval-list order, repeated identically four times
